title: Signs your website is a template,
subtitle: Five things owners usually find out only after launch.

items.title: Same theme as your competitors
items.description: The same theme your competitors bought, with your logo swapped in. Nothing on it is yours to change.

items.title: Slow on phones
items.description: Fast on the office Wi‑Fi it was demoed on. Your visitors arrive on phones, on mobile data.

items.title: No real handover
items.description: A password and a zip file. No documentation, no architecture, no record of why anything was built the way it was.

items.title: Every change costs more
items.description: Made to be signed off, not to grow. Every new feature costs more than the one before it.

items.title: No developer you can reach
items.description: A coordinator relays your questions to a team you never meet. Every technical answer waits for the relay.
